full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph looks along a quiet unpaved lane in a sparsely built residential area beneath a broad cloud-filled sky. The lower half is a light gravel or dirt surface, its faint wheel tracks drawing the eye from the foreground into the distant center-left. A dark tree spreads its canopy along the left edge and throws an irregular shadow across the near ground. Farther back, a modest pale one-story house sits just right of center, with a pitched roof, a dark rectangular window, and a small upright point at the roofline. Other low structures and shrubs recede along the lane. Near the right edge, an older light-colored car is parked beside a small building; its rear, rounded roof, and dark back window face the viewer at a slight angle. A tall wooden utility pole rises behind the car, its crossarm silhouetted against the clouds. Several wires stretch diagonally from it across the open sky and down toward other smaller poles in the distance. The upper half contains large bright cumulus clouds with gray undersides, separated by a medium-gray sky. The clouds give the otherwise plain setting a strong changing pattern of light and shade. Direct daylight creates crisp but not harsh shadows beneath the tree and across the road, while the pale house and car stand out from darker foliage. The scene is observed at eye level, without a dramatic tilt or close crop. Fine film-like grain and a complete range of gray values preserve the surface of dirt, leaves, siding, and cloud. No people are visible and no lettering is readable. The overall composition is spacious and understated, using the converging lane, utility lines, and broad luminous sky to give an ordinary roadside view a patient, measured presence.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白纪实照片：视线沿着一条安静的未铺装道路伸向稀疏建筑的居住区，上方是开阔而多云的天空。下半幅为浅色碎石或泥土路面，隐约车辙从前景把目光带向远处偏左的中央。左边缘一棵深色树展开树冠，在近处地面投下不规则阴影。更远处，一座朴素的浅色单层房屋位于中央偏右，有斜屋顶、深色矩形窗和屋脊上一处小突起。其他低矮建筑与灌木沿路渐渐退去。靠近右边缘，一辆旧式浅色汽车停在一座小建筑旁；车尾、圆润车顶和深色后窗以轻微角度朝向观众。一根高木电线杆在汽车后方升起，横担在云前形成剪影。几道电线从那里斜穿开阔天空，并延向远处更小的线杆。上半幅是大片明亮的积云和灰色云底，云间露出中灰天空。云朵为本来朴素的环境带来有力而变化的明暗纹样。直射日光在树下和道路上造成清楚却不刺眼的阴影，浅色屋子与汽车则从较暗树丛前突出。画面以平视角度观察，没有戏剧性的倾斜或紧贴裁切。细微胶片般颗粒与完整灰阶保留泥土、树叶、房屋板面和云的表面特征。画中没有人，也没有可读字迹。整体构图开阔而低调，以逐渐汇聚的道路、电线和大片发亮天空，赋予平凡路边景象耐心而沉稳的存在感。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white documentary photography treats ordinary spaces with level, patient framing and a full but restrained range of gray. Broad open areas balance small clusters of structures and vegetation, while linear elements draw the eye gradually through the depth of the frame. Bright cloudlike tonal masses can occupy a large share of the composition without washing out darker ground textures. Direct natural light forms readable shadows, though contrast remains moderate enough to retain detail in both pale and dark regions. Fine grain gives varied surfaces a consistent photographic character. The overall effect is quiet and observational, with spatial clarity and everyday texture carrying the image.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白纪实摄影以平稳、耐心的画框和完整而克制的灰阶观看日常空间。宽阔开放区域与小型结构、植被群组平衡，线性元素引导视线缓缓穿过画面纵深。明亮的云状明度大块可以占据构图很大部分，却不冲淡较暗地面肌理。自然直射光形成可辨阴影，同时对比保持适中，让浅处和深处都留有细节。细微颗粒赋予各种表面一致的摄影特质。整体效果安静而重在观察，空间清晰度和日常质地共同支撑画面。
theme_en: A quiet dirt lane with a small house, parked car and broad clouds
theme_zh: 一条安静土路旁有小屋、停放的汽车和大片云层
name: Robert Adams
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
